lines.1: 「Come to think of it, there's something I wanted to ask.」
lines.3: 「What did you finally put on your career survey?」
lines.11: 「I am going to work at Flower Shop YASI.」
lines.12: 「Oh, right. Your family owns a flower shop. You're taking it over.」
lines.13: 「That's not fair. You do have a dream.」
lines.17: 「But your mother looked healthy, and your father is around, right? You don't necessarily have to inherit it.」
lines.19: 「My father died of an illness when I was little.」
lines.22: 「That is the situation. Does that answer your question?」
lines.24: 「...You told me quite a lot about yourself.」
lines.25: 「I would call it complaining, not telling you about myself.」
lines.26: 「I say whatever I please to you, Senpai, so I took the opportunity to complain as well.」
lines.27: 「At least you know you say whatever you please.」
lines.28: 「I do not think that is wrong.」
lines.29: 「Good night, then. I imagine the Princess has calmed down by now.」
lines.32: She had to take over the shop...
lines.33: There were still several things that didn't sit right with me...
